newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TIETMEYER SEES NO CONCERN ABOUT DLR, FX IN G10.
newsitem.headline: TIETMEYER SEES NO CONCERN ABOUT DLR, FX IN G10.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said that there was no reason for concern about the overall exchange rate markets, including dollar rates, among Group of 10 (G10) central bank governors.
Tietmeyer, speaking to reporters, said the G10 central bank governors had discussed the current overall exchange rate situation during their regular monthly meeting.
"Until now, we don't see any special concerns as far as the exchange market is concerned," he said.
Tietmeyer said the central bank governors had discussed the current state of world exchange markets overall.
"I'm not talking about the rates of one currency to another," Tietmeyer said.
"I am talking about the whole situation of the dollar vis-a-vis Europe, the dollar vis-a-vis Japan (and) the situation inside Europe," he said.
"So all in all, we didn't see any point of some concern," he said without elaborating.
He was briefing reporters after a regular monthly meeting here of G10 central bankers held at the Bank for International Settlements (BIS).
